ns2:course.label: Jazz Piano Improvisation II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of MUS 160. Study of jazz theory, harmony, and improvisational techniques at the piano; includes experience in solo and ensemble situations, and a historical survey of jazz development from about 1910. Prerequisite: MUS 160 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 160 or consent of instructor.
